note: Compiled 2026-11-06. Each URL was requested on that date. 'blocked' means the site refused an automated request (or served a bot challenge that answers every address alike), so the page was not confirmed on that date. Whether a resource is fully free or has a paid tier was judged from its pages on that date, or from general knowledge where the site was blocked, and may change. Descriptions are this project's own words. Levels are empty unless the publisher states them.
